basic_details.job_title: ESIC Faridabad Faculty Recruitment 2026 – Walkin for 19 Professor, Associate & Assistant Professor Posts
basic_details.short_information: ESIC Medical College & Hospital, Faridabad, under the Employees' State Insurance Corporation (Ministry of Labour & Employment, Government of India), will hold a walk-in interview on 27 November 2026 for 19 teaching faculty posts on a contract basis. The posts are 7 Professor, 11 Associate Professor and 1 Assistant Professor posts in 10 super specialty departments and 1 broad specialty department. Candidates must report between 9:00 AM and 10:00 AM at the Examination Hall, Academic Block of the college in Faridabad, with the offline application and self-attested copies of their documents.

age_limit.details: For all posts, the age must be not exceeding 69 years as on date of interview. Tenure is till 70 years maximum. The notice does not mention any age relaxation.

important_instructions: Contract duration: initially 1 year, extendable up to 3 years, subject to approval and satisfactory performance. Service can be terminated at any time in public interest. Resignation requires one-month notice or one-month salary in lieu. There is no entitlement to service benefits (PF, pension, gratuity, etc.). Hostel/quarters are subject to availability. Attendance is mandatory via the biometric system. No private practice is allowed. False information leads to cancellation. The Dean, ESIC MCH, Faridabad reserves the right to cancel or postpone the recruitment. No TA/DA is paid for the interview. Candidates should check the website regularly for updates.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: ESIC Medical College & Hospital, Faridabad has advertised 19 faculty posts in total. The table gives the count and the consolidated monthly pay for each post. The notice prints the pay under the heading "Basic Pay (Fixed)". **An assistant professor is working on the seat of associate professor (Neonatology, Associate Professor). The same qualification rule applies to the Professor, Associate Professor and Assistant Professor posts: As per latest NMC (National Medical Commission) guidelines. NMC Notification (30/06/2025) on "Medical Institutions (Qualification of Faculty) Regulations 2025" will apply. The cut-off date for eligibility is as on the date of interview. The discipline-specific eligibility for each post is set out in the official notification and the NMC regulations it names. For all posts, the age must be not exceeding 69 years as on date of interview. Tenure is till 70 years maximum. The notice does not mention any age relaxation. The security deposit is refundable upon completion of the contract and submission of a No Dues Certificate. It is forfeited if the candidate resigns within six months, except under exceptional circumstances.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in ESIC Faridabad Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 19 faculty vacancies: 7 Professor, 11 Associate Professor and 1 Assistant Professor posts, in 10 super specialty departments and the Reproductive Medicine & Surgery broad specialty department.

faq.question: Q2. When and where is the ESIC Faridabad walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 27 November 2026 at the Examination Hall, Academic Block, ESIC Medical College & Hospital, Faridabad. Candidates must report between 9:00 AM and 10:00 AM.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for ESIC Faridabad faculty posts?
faq.answer: The qualification is as per the latest NMC (National Medical Commission) guidelines. The NMC Notification (30/06/2025) on the "Medical Institutions (Qualification of Faculty) Regulations 2025" will apply.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for ESIC Faridabad faculty recruitment?
faq.answer: The age must be not exceeding 69 years as on date of interview, and tenure is till 70 years maximum.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of a Professor at ESIC Faridabad?
faq.answer: A Professor gets a consolidated pay of ₹2,63,070 per month. An Associate Professor gets ₹1,74,936 per month and an Assistant Professor gets ₹1,50,294 per month.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for ESIC Faridabad faculty posts?
faq.answer: The fee is ₹500 for the Others category, paid by Demand Draft in favour of "ESI Fund A/c No.1", payable at Faridabad. It is Nil for SC/ST/ESIC Employees, Female Candidates, Ex-servicemen and PwD.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for ESIC Faridabad Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Submit the offline application attached with the advertisement, with self-attested copies of documents, and attend the walk-in interview on 27 November 2026. A separate application is required for each post.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected?
faq.answer: Selection is based on academic credentials and interview performance. Results will be posted on www.esic.gov.in, and the offer of appointment will be sent via email.

faq.question: Q9. Is the ESIC Faridabad faculty job permanent?
faq.answer: No, the posts are on a contract basis. The contract is initially for 1 year, extendable up to 3 years, and gives no entitlement to PF, pension or gratuity.

faq.question: Q10. Is there a security deposit for selected candidates?
faq.answer: Yes, there is a security deposit of ₹20,000 for each post, paid by Demand Draft in favour of "ESI Fund A/c No.1". It is forfeited if the candidate resigns within six months, except under exceptional circumstances.
